blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The International Criminal Court (ICC) Trial Chamber III will hold another status conference on the crimes against humanity case against former President Rodrigo Duterte on Wednesday, Sept. 16. In this third status conference, the chamber will tackle several topics involving the prosecution’s case against Duterte, particularly its list of witnesses, list of evidence, their disclosure to the defense, other possible incidents, as well as the amount of time to be allotted to the prosecution to present its case.
